data.one_liner: Converts strings or hashes into unique HEX strings or color integer values.
data.what_it_does: Provides static methods to convert any input String into a unique hexadecimal string or a unique integer compatible with Flutter's Color class. It allows mapping text to consistent color representations or custom hex values.
use_when: You need to dynamically generate consistent, unique colors for user avatars or tags based on string names.
You want to convert strings to hex representations easily without boilerplate.
avoid_when: You require complex cryptographic hashing functions (use the crypto package instead).
You need strictly controlled color palettes rather than algorithmically generated ones.
strengths: Very simple and straightforward API with static methods.
Supports null safety and crosses multiple platforms seamlessly.
weaknesses: Very narrow scope focused only on string-to-hex and string-to-color conversion.
Limited documentation beyond the basic README methods.

alternatives.name: crypto
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need standard cryptographic hashing algorithms like MD5 or SHA instead of custom string-to-hex utilities.

data.minimal_example:
var myNiceColor = StringToHex.toColor('your nice string');
Color(myNiceColor);
